requirements: R1: Transmit OAuth2/OIDC access token securely using Authorization: Bearer header to userinfo endpoint instead of URL query parameter

slices.title: Secure token transmission in userinfo fetch
slices.jtbd: When implementing secure token transmission for this epic, I want to use the Authorization header, so that the userinfo endpoint request does not leak credentials in the URL query string
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid authentication token
When fetching the user profile from the userinfo endpoint
Then it is passed in the Authorization header
And tests verify no token is sent as a query parameter
